item.title: Testing the Web Layer with @WebMvcTest and MockMvc
item.description: Controller tests verify HTTP mapping, request parsing, validation, serialization, and security — without starting a full server. @WebMvcTest + MockMvc gives you a fast, focused web layer test. @WebMvcTest — What It Loads @WebMvcTest(OrderController.class) class OrderControllerTest { // Spring loads: // - Your @Controller class (and its dependencies) // - DispatcherServlet, MVC configuration // - Jackson ObjectMapper // - Security (if configured) // // Spring does NOT load: // - @Service, @Repository beans // - Database, JPA // // You @MockBean all services } Basic Controller Test @WebMvcTest(OrderController.
